rule_gaps: 'kjede' is both 'chain' and 'necklace' in Norwegian — Shimano bicycle chains land in Jewelry with type=Necklaces; require a jewellery crumb before 'kjede' may set Necklaces
'perle' as a substring promotes non-jewellery into Jewelry: Gardena 'PERLESTRÅLE' hose adapter (Garden), Vtwonen 'Puff Perle' pouffe (Furniture), Prym 'Perlegrå' knitting needles (Hobby)

Jewelry's derived type falls back to 'Rings' for rows with no jewellery word at all — ski wax, mop pads, pool chemicals, floor washers and cleaning pads all carry type=Rings; emit nothing instead of a default

material is derived from any colour word: 'Gull'/'Sølv' as an ink colour ('703 Gull', 'Pentouch 5.0 Sølv'), a brass/steel finish ('Antikk sølv') or even a plain silver name ('830 hvitt sølv' → Gold) all set material wrongly

Norwegian silver-cutlery vocabulary is unmapped (skje, gaffel, kniv, kakespade, sauseøse, spisekniv) so Mestergull's whole cutlery-pattern catalogue under the vague 'Hjem > Produkter' breadcrumb lands in Jewelry instead of Kitchen — 11 rows in this shard alone
sewing/haberdashery vocabulary unmapped (sikkerhetsnåler, knapper, parpinner, buksespenner, vaskenåler, sytilbehør) → Hobby; every Tegne.no Prym row is here
writing-instrument vocabulary unmapped (skrivesaker, pennetui, refill, penn, kalligrafipenner) → Office/Hobby; 10 Montblanc/Pilot/Sakura rows are here
winter-sport vocabulary unmapped (skismøring, glideprodukter, frikjøringsski, VINTERSPORT) → Sport
shard-wide low gap: chain and set rows never get a type — Perlekjede, Singaporekjede, Slangekjede, Rosettsmykke and Smykkesett all sit with type unset although the name or srcCat states it
notes: The genuine jewellery two thirds of this shard (David-Andersen, Mestergull and Bjørklund ring/chain rows) is clean and well-facetted; the damage is that Jewelry acts as the sink for any row whose breadcrumb didn't resolve — 55 of 300 rows are not jewellery at all (ski wax, bike chains, pens, cleaning fluid, a pouffe, a camera gear ring), and Mestergull's silver-cutlery patterns are the single biggest block. Variant wiring is absent everywhere: 45 rows are plainly colour/size/carat siblings sitting as separate top-level products. Image coverage is poor at 118/300, and no product in the shard has more than one offer, so nothing here is actually comparing prices yet.
